1: Quraysh ki aadat aur un ki waqfiyat ki wajah se,
2: ke woh jaare mein Yemen ki taraf aur garmi mein Shaam ki taraf, aman ke saath safar karte thay,
3: unhein chahiye ke sirf Allah ki ibadat karein, jo is mohtaram ghar ka Rubb hai. Wohi hai jis ne un ke liye yeh safar aasan kiye. Unhein us ke saath kisi ko shareek nahin thehrana chahiye.
4: Wohi hai jis ne unhein bhook se bacha kar khana diya, aur Haram aur us ke rehne walon ki azmat logon ke dilon mein daal kar unhein khauf se aman diya.
